verdict.rationale: LanceDB's docs confirm core ANN vector search (top-k nearest neighbor), with vector indexing, quantization, and metadata filtering support, and community evidence corroborates filter pushdown functionality. Distance metric configurability is implied by the vector-index/quantization docs but not explicitly enumerated in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit documentation listing configurable distance metrics (e.g., cosine, L2, dot), and independent hands-on benchmarking of ANN recall/quality.
